name: Corporate Action Option 243
definition: Provides information about the corporate action option.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

OptionFeatures.name: Option Features
OptionFeatures.definition: Specifies the features that may apply to a corporate action option.

FractionDisposition.name: Fraction Disposition
FractionDisposition.definition: Specifies how fractional amount/quantities are treated.

ChangeType.name: Change Type
ChangeType.definition: Type of changes affecting the security form.

EligibleForCollateralIndicator.name: Eligible For Collateral Indicator
EligibleForCollateralIndicator.definition: Indicates that the corporate action instruction is to be processed using the Available-for-Collateral pool.

SolicitationDealerFeeIndicator.name: Solicitation Dealer Fee Indicator
SolicitationDealerFeeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is a solicitation fee on the event. This fee is paid by the soliciting dealer.

CurrencyToBuy.name: Currency To Buy
CurrencyToBuy.definition: Account servicer is instructed to buy the indicated currency after the receipt of cash proceeds.

CurrencyToSell.name: Currency To Sell
CurrencyToSell.definition: Account servicer is instructed to sell the indicated currency in order to obtain the necessary currency to fund the transaction within this instruction message.

CurrencyOption.name: Currency Option
CurrencyOption.definition: Currency in which cash proceeds are to be credited or debited.

SecuritiesQuantityOrInstructedAmount.name: Securities Quantity Or Instructed Amount
SecuritiesQuantityOrInstructedAmount.definition: Provides information about securities quantity linked to a corporate action option.

ExecutionRequestedDateTime.name: Execution Requested Date Time
ExecutionRequestedDateTime.definition: Date/time at which the instructing party requests the instruction to be executed.

RateAndAmountDetails.name: Rate And Amount Details
RateAndAmountDetails.definition: Provides information about rates and amounts related to a corporate action option.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Provides information about the prices related to a corporate action option.

ShareholderNumber.name: Shareholder Number
ShareholderNumber.definition: Reference number assigned to identify an investor or a shareholder with the issuer or the registration provider (for instance allocation code).

OptionNumber1Rule.definition: For differentiation between options, the OptionNumber rather than the OptionType must be used, for example, in the case where two or more offers can be described by the same corporate action option code. Therefore, the OptionNumber value must be different for each option.

OptionNumber2Rule.definition: When the CorporateActionInstruction is unsolicited, that is, the instruction has not been preceded by a Corporate ActionNotification, then OptionNumber/code must be UNSO (unsolicited).
